params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Neeko''' has a collection of disguises to take on the appearance of allied {{tip|champions}}, displayed on her ''Disguise Menu''. She can use the menu to activate a disguise, switch her current disguise to a different one, or deactivate the current disguise by selecting herself, all of which place ''Inherent Glamour'' on a {{fd|0.5}}-second cooldown. Taking damage from a champion or {{tip|turret}} while not disguised puts ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 2-second cooldown.
params.description4: Breaking the disguise via dying, being immobilized or taking damage from a turret puts ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 2-second cooldown, entering the enemy spawn platform does not put it on cooldown, and all other methods of breaking the disguise put ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 1-second cooldown.
params.description5: ''Inherent Glamour's disguise is not deactivated from {{ai|Pop Blossom|Neeko}} until after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of its cast. '''Neeko''' cannot activate Inherent Glamour while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables casting abilities.''

Before disguising

[[File:Neeko Disguise Menu HUD.png|300px|right|thumb|Disguise menu on the HUD]] * '''Neeko's''' disguise collection is offered through a special ''Disguise Menu'' in the HUD. The menu holds up to 5 ''slots'', based on the number of allied {{tip|champions}}. The player can select a disguise by {{LMB}} clicking on their portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F5}}). The ''Sho'Ma'' disguise can be discarded by clicking on the 'x' next to the disguise's icon or via the sixth Champion Specific Interaction hotkey (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F6}}). ** The ''slot'' containing her ''Sho'Ma'' disguise will be third in the HUD if there are two or more allied champions in the game, otherwise it will be the rightmost ''slot''. The remaining ''slots'' will contain allied champion disguises in order of their appearance in the pre-game [[Loading Screen]]. * Casting '''Inherent Glamour''' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}, {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive, and does not interrupt {{ai|Shapesplitter|Neeko|the clone's}} movement orders. * '''Neeko''' does not begin storing ''Sho'Ma'' from a unit if that unit enters her {{tip|sight}} and gathering range at the same time, or if it is within gathering range when she loses the disguise. * The progress of gathering ''Sho'Ma'' from a unit is not lost even if '''Neeko''' stores ''Sho'Ma'' from a different unit. * ''Inherent Glamour's'' cooldown only prevents '''Neeko''' from activating disguises; she can still store and remove ''Sho'Ma'' while the passive is on cooldown. * When disguising while storing ''Sho'Ma'' from a unit, '''Neeko''' continues to store ''Sho'Ma'' from that unit. * '''Neeko''' cannot store ''Sho'Ma'' from {{ai|Dark Procession|Yorick}} and {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}. * After successfully storing ''Sho'Ma'', Neeko celebrates by clapping. ** This animation is forced and overrides all other animations except {{ais|Pop Blossom|Neeko}} landing animation. * If '''Neeko''' attempts to activate a disguise while near the {{tip|stealthed trap|trap}}, {{tip|ward}}, or [[jungle plants|jungle plant]] she stored ''Sho'Ma'' from, she will {{tip|lunge|leap}} to that unit's exact position over 1 second, though not through terrain, and then become disguised. If she does so for a monster and is near its respective jungle camp, she will leap to that monster's usual position in the camp. ** If the monster is any {{ui|Krug}}, she will leap to the ''large'' Krug's position in the camp on the blue side or ''medium'' Krug's position on the red side. ** If the monster is {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} or a ''lesser'' {{ui|Raptor}}, she will leap to its position at the time of storing ''Sho'Ma'' instead.{{bug}} ** The leap is interrupted if '''Neeko''' attacks, moves, or casts certain abilities and spells. *** The disguise will still activate after 1 second if the leap is interrupted by moving or attacking. ** '''Neeko''' cannot gather ''Sho'Ma'' while leaping. ** She will fail to activate the disguise after the leap if she is affected by the same conditions that would break a disguise. ** ''Inherent Glamour's'' leap has a number of interactions that set it apart from other {{tip|lunge|lunges}}: **# ''Inherent Glamour's'' leap does not interact with {{iis|Voltaic Cyclosword}} {{nie|Galvanize}} passive; **# ''Inherent Glamour's'' leap does not override the forced movement inflicted by {{tip|airborne}} effects; **# The path of ''Inherent Glamour's'' leap will be similar to the path '''Neeko''' would take if ordered to move to the unit's position instead. ** '''Neeko''' will copy the unit's facing direction when disguising after leaping. ** If '''Neeko''' does not arrive at the unit's position while leaping, she will continue moving toward it. * While not disguised, attempting to cast ''Inherent Glamour'' during a cast time or {{tip|attack windup}} puts the ability on cooldown immediately, but postpones the disguise. ** Doing so while disguised will not postpone the effect and will interrupt the {{tip|attack windup}}. ** This allows '''Neeko''' to successfully disguise even if she gets affected by effects that would put ''Inherent Glamour'' on cooldown during the delay.{{bug|2}} * '''Neeko''' can activate ''Inherent Glamour'' while {{tip|channel|channeling}}, and remain in the disguise during the channel.{{bug|2}} * '''Neeko''' can activate ''Inherent Glamour'' while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, and remain in the disguise during the immobilization, despite the fact that immobilizations are meant to break the disguise.{{bug|2}}

While disguised

* '''Neeko''' will copy aesthetics as well as superficial mechanical [[Champion statistic|statistics]]. She will fake a number of readings: ** [[Health|Health bar]] (original's current amount becomes her apparent maximum) *** While disguised as {{ci|Kled}}, '''Neeko's''' health bar simulates a [[Health#Health_threshold|health threshold]], but does not color '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|health}} properly.{{bug}} ** [[Ability Resource|Secondary resource]] - e.g. {{as|mana}}, {{as|energy}} or none at all (original's current amount becomes her apparent maximum) *** If disguised as a {{ui|Blue Siege Minion|Siege Minion}}, '''Neeko''' cannot see her mana bar.{{bug}} ** [[Ammunition]] ** [[Champion statistic|Stats]] ** {{tip|Buff|Buffs}} and {{tip|Debuff|debuffs}} with their respective icons and VFX/SFX (there are exceptions) *** '''Neeko''' sees the buffs that are actually applied to her, while enemies see the disguise's form's buffs. **** Although '''Neeko''' can see the buffs, she cannot read their descriptions by hovering their icons.{{bug}} **** After gaining a charge of {{nie|Shared Riches}} ({{ii|World Atlas}}, {{ii|Runic Compass}}), '''Neeko''' is unable to see the charge count until she consumes a charge.{{bug}} ** [[Experience (champion)|Level]] ** Kill feed icon ** Minimap icon * A number of attributes she actually adopts are: ** {{as|'''Base''' movement speed}} if it is lower than '''Neeko's''' {{as|'''base'''|movement speed}} *** While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko's''' {{as|'''total''' movement speed}} cannot be reduced below {{as|200|movement speed}}. *** While disguised as a ward or plant, '''Neeko's''' {{as|'''total''' movement speed}} cannot be increased above {{as|200|movement speed}}, except via effects that set {{as|movement speed}} to a certain value ({{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}}). **** {{pending for test}} Is this true for traps? ** Classification of the unit (e.g. {{ui|Blue Melee Minion|melee}}, {{ui|Blue Siege Minion|siege}} minion; large, small monster; ward) *** '''Neeko''' is never considered a minion for the purposes of {{ii|Reinforced Armor (Turret Item)|Reinforced Armor}}. ** {{tt|Base range type of the unit ({{tip|melee}}, {{tip|ranged}})|does not inherit transformations that change the range classification, with exceptions}} *** {{tip|Wards}} are considered to be melee, while [[jungle plants]] and {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} are considered to be ranged. *** When disguising as {{ci|Nidalee}} in {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee|Cougar Form}} or {{ci|Elise}} in {{ai|Spider Form|Elise|Spider Form}}, '''Neeko''' is special cased to become {{tip|melee}}. ** {{as|'''Base''' attack speed}} and attack ratio *** When disguising as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' instead has her {{as|'''total''' attack speed}} set to that of the disguise's form, or to {{fd|2.0}} if the disguise's form's {{as|'''total''' attack speed}} is any higher. *** Although {{ci|Jhin}} gains additional base attack speed through [[growth]], '''Neeko''' only inherits his level 1 base attack speed value.{{bug}} ** {{tip|Basic attack}} damage type ({{tip|basic damage}}, {{tip|ability damage}}), and subtype ({{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}}, {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}}) *** For example, many {{tip|pets}} deal ability damage instead of basic damage with their basic attacks. **** However, {{tip|critical strikes}} from non-champions always deal {{as|physical}} basic damage. ** The {{tip|projectile}} or non-projectile quality of their attack and projectile speed, if applicable *** When {{tip|critical strike|striking critically}} as a non-champion with a projectile attack, the attack projectile is invisible and hits near-instantly, but can still be intercepted by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and similar abilities. ** {{sti|attack range|'''Base''' attack range}} of the unit's base form *** For example, in the case of {{ci|Gnar}}, she will adopt {{tt|{{ccd|Gnar|range}}|Gnar's base range}} attack range. *** When disguising as {{ci|Nidalee}} in {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee|Cougar Form}} or {{ci|Elise}} in {{ai|Spider Form|Elise|Spider Form}}, '''Neeko''' is special cased to adopt {{tt|125 range|the range they gain when they transform}} as her base range. ** Damage dealt to champions ({{as|physical|physical damage}}, {{as|magical|magic damage}}) ratio for the purposes of {{cai|Adaptive Defenses|Camille}}. ** {{tip|Size}} (including size modifiers and base unit size) at the time of disguising ** {{tip|Pathing radius}} when disguising as a non-champion *** {{pending for test}} Is the same true for champions? ** Voice lines ** Base unit model, not accounting for the unit's current except in {{tt|special cases|see the visual effects section}} ** Default transformation toggle (non-innate) ** Character interactions (jokes, taunts, dances, laughs, toggle effects), as well as their {{si|Recall}} animation *** '''Neeko''' can copy {{cis|Samira}} taunt animation but she will not actually throw the coin via the {{ai|Taunt|Samira|image = Samira splash coin.png}} ability. *** While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' will play her laugh sound when attempting to laugh. *** {{note|1}} This is an intentional feature, requested by fans when '''Neeko's''' [[V13.9]] gameplay update was released. **** While disguised as a {{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|''Packmate''}}, she will play {{cis|Naafiri}} laugh instead. * Both '''Neeko''' and the disguise's form take damage based on her real '''current''' {{as|{{sti|health}}}}, {{as|{{sti|armor}}}}, and {{as|{{sti|magic resistance}}}}. ** While disguised as a {{tip|minion|lane minion}}, '''Neeko''' uniquely [[Minion#Stats_mechanics|takes {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} from minions]] based on the disguise's form's health. * While disguised as a non-champion, for the purposes of [[combat status]], '''Neeko''' is considered a champion when dealing damage, but not when taking damage. * Enemy {{tip|turret|turrets}} and {{tip|minions}} still aggro '''Neeko''' while she is disguised as a neutral {{tip|monster}} or [[jungle plants|jungle plant]]. * While disguised as a plant or ward, '''Neeko''' can be targeted by minions and affected by most effects that normally don't affect them. * {{pending for test}} which abilities, runes and items do / don't interact with wards, plants and wardlike entities? * While disguised as a unit not targetable by turrets (e.g. wards, traps, {{ai|Sentinel|Kalista}}, {{ai|Prophet of an Elder God|Illaoi|Tentacle}}), '''Neeko''' cannot be targeted by turrets until she damages a champion. ** Disguising as a unit not targetable by turrets does not drop ongoing turret aggro. * While disguised as a jungle plant or {{tip|stealthed trap|trap}}, '''Neeko's''' facing direction visually appears to not change while moving. ** '''Neeko's''' real facing direction is, however, affected by movement for the purposes of direction-facing effects (e.g. {{ai|Petrifying Gaze|Cassiopeia}}, {{ai|Backstab|Shaco}}). * Disguising as a {{ui|Blast Cone}} or {{ui|Scryer's Bloom}} creates their respective ''roots'' at '''Neeko's''' location at the time of disguise. ** {{pending for test}} when do they disappear? * Disguising as a monster does not cause '''Neeko's''' {{tip|attack windup}} to not be cancelled if the target moves out of range. * While disguised as a ward, '''Neeko''' can be {{tip|disabled ward|disabled}} by {{tip|control ward|control wards}}, but not by {{tip|sweeper drone|sweeper drones}} or {{iis|Umbral Glaive}} {{nie|Blackout}}.{{bug}} ** While disguised as a ward, '''Neeko''' does not trigger ''Blackout''. * While disguised as a ward, when attacked by champions using {{ii|Umbral Glaive}}, '''Neeko''' takes damage from {{nie|Extinguish}}, but the disguise's form does not.{{bug}} ** {{pending for test}} did Umbral Glaive interactions change after [[V26.01]]? * While disguised as a ward, when standing within a 225 radius of a {{bi|Faelights|faelight}}, '''Neeko'' will mimic superward VFX for {{tt|39 seconds|estimated}}, or until her disguise is broken or she leaves the faelight location. ** While stationary, and within 75-225 radius of a faelight, '''Neeko''' will {{tip|blink}} into a 75 radius of the faelight's location. * Disguising as a non-champion interrupts the cast time of {{cai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}} if it is targeting '''Neeko'''. * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' can be targeted by {{cai|Focused Resolve|Karma}} and {{ai|Renewal|Karma}}.{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' can be directly hit by {{cai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' cannot be affected by {{cai|Deadly Flourish|Jhin}}, {{cais|Powerball|Rammus}} negative effects, cannot be {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} by {{cai|Dragon Strike|Jarvan IV}}, and cannot attach {{cai|Time Bomb|Zilean}} to herself.{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' cannot be tethered by {{cai|Bastion|Taric}}. If she was tethered before changing, the tether will break as soon as she changes into a non-champion and Taric's spells can not be mimicked onto her. Once she changes into a champion the tether will automatically come back. * {{ai|Requiem|Karthus}} does not affect '''Neeko''' while disguised as a non-champion if {{ci|Karthus}} is casting it during {{ai|Death Defied|Karthus}}, but does otherwise.{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' breaks {{bi|Mountain Dragon Soul|Mountain Dragon Soul's shield}}. * While disguised as a non-champion, allied champions using {{nie|Shared Riches}} ({{ii|World Atlas}}, {{ii|Runic Compass}}) while '''Neeko''' is nearby will {{tip|execute}} minions and trigger the VFX without spending a charge or awarding {{g|gold}} to '''Neeko'''. * While disguised as a non-champion, enemy {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}} indicator will not be displayed on '''Neeko''', but she will still be affected by the empowered attack. * Abilities and item actives with champion {{tip|forgiveness radius|targeting forgiveness}} (e.g. {{cai|All Out|K'Sante}}, {{cai|Inspire|Karma}}, {{cai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}) can be cast on '''Neeko''' even while she is disguised as a non-champion.{{bug}} * While disguised as a minion or monster, '''Neeko''' cannot be {{tip|fear|feared}} by {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}}.{{bug}} * While disguised as a monster, '''Neeko''' cannot be targeted by {{si|Smite}}.{{bug}} * While disguised as a monster, '''Neeko''' does not receive damage from {{si|Primal Smite}}.{{bug}} ** While disguised as a monster, '''Neeko''' receives full damage as a monster from {{si|Unleashed Smite}}. * While disguised as {{ai|Daisy!|Ivern|Daisy}}, '''Neeko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} will not deal damage.{{bug}} ** After gaining the {{ai|Brushmaker|Ivern}} buff for the first time, '''Neeko's''' basic attacks while disguised as ''Daisy'' will do {{as|100% '''total''' AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, but the damage will be attributed to {{ci|Ivern}}, allowing '''Neeko''' to attack turrets without breaking the disguise, as well as apply his {{tip|on-hit}} effects instead of her own.{{bug}} *** This also allows '''Neeko''' to apply stacks of ''Daisy Smash!'' without consuming any, which can allow ''Daisy'' to cast ''Daisy Smash!'' multiple times within 3 seconds.{{bug}} * While disguised as {{ui|Blue Sentinel}} or {{ui|Red Brambleback}}, '''Neeko's''' attacks use a different animation cycle from the original monster's and sometimes show VFX from the removed ''Voidborn'' forms of the monsters.{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' cannot receive {{bi|Crest of Insight}} and {{bi|Crest of Cinders}} by killing {{ui|Blue Sentinel}} and {{ui|Red Brambleback}}.{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' is not {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} when taking damage from {{cais|New Destiny|Graves}} pellets.{{bug}} * While disguised as {{ci|Graves}}, '''Neeko's''' attacks visually imitate ''New Destiny's'' pellets, but only deal damage with his {{tt|invisible missile|Graves uses an invisible missile to apply ''Energized'' effects and attack wards}}. * While disguised as {{cai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}} or {{cai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie|Tibbers}}, '''Neeko's''' basic attacks will only deal {{as|100% '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|magic damage}}.{{bug}} ** If '''Neeko''' has no {{as|'''bonus''' AD}}, she will not deal damage. ** However, '''Neeko's''' {{tip|critical strikes}} while disguised will deal {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Neeko|crit_base}}|100|mod={{ccd|Neeko|crit_mod}}}} '''total''' AD}} {{as|physical damage}} as expected. * While disguised as {{ai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie|Tibbers}}, '''Neeko's''' attacks do not interact with {{ri|Arcane Comet}}.{{bug}} * While disguised as {{cis|Bel'Veth}} [[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|border]] [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Void Remora]], {{cai|Deadly Spines|Zyra|Thorn Spitters}} or {{ai|Grasping Roots|Zyra|Vine Lashers}}, '''Neeko''' cannot issue a basic attack command. * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' takes reduced damage from {{cis|Kled}} {{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounted}} attacks{{bug}}, but is not considered a champion for the ability's other effects. * '''Neeko''' benefits from ''{{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled|Mr. Kled's Wild Ride}}'' even while disguised as a lane minion, {{ui|Voidmite}} or [[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|border]] [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Void Remora]].{{bug}} * While disguised as a non-champion, '''Neeko''' cannot purchase items exclusive to {{tip|melee}} or {{tip|ranged}} champions (eg. {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}) regardless of her current range type.{{bug}} * '''Neeko''' cannot purchase {{ii|Elixir of Iron}}, {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}} , {{ii|Elixir of Wrath}}, {{ii|Farsight Alteration}} while disguised as a unit with a lower level than required. ** '''Neeko''' will fail to purchase these items when disguising as a unit of required level if her real level is lower than required.

Breaking the disguise

* ''Inherent Glamour's'' disguise is broken by the following actions: ** Casting {{ai|Q|Neeko}} or {{ai|E|Neeko}}. *** Casting {{ai|R|Neeko}} will not break the disguise immediately, but after a delay. ** Using {{si|Exhaust}}, {{si|Ignite}}, {{si|Smite}}, {{si|Unleashed Smite}}, {{si|Primal Smite}}, or {{si|Mark}}. *** Using {{si|Dash}} will not break the disguise. ** Activating the following items: *** {{ii|Hextech Gunblade}} *** {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}} *** {{ii|Profane Hydra}} *** {{ii|Randuin's Omen}} *** {{ii|Ravenous Hydra}} *** {{ii|Redemption}} *** {{ii|Stridebreaker}} *** {{ii|Tiamat}} *** {{ii|Titanic Hydra}} * While disguised as a champion{{bug|2}}, dealing {{tip|ability damage}} to champions with abilities or items will also break the disguise. * {{cai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} is special cased to break the disguise and put it on a 2-second cooldown both before damaging '''Neeko''' and while targeting her. * Damage dealt by {{ui|Voidmite|Voidmites}} summoned by '''Neeko''' will be attributed to '''Neeko''' and will break the disguise if the disguise's form is a non-champion.{{bug|2}} ** This includes Voidmites summoned by [[File:Rift Herald Rodeo buff.png|Rift Herald Rodeo|20px|link=Rift Herald#Summoned form]] [[Rift Herald#Abilities|Rift Herald Rodeo]] if Rift Herald was {{tip|attached}} to '''Neeko''' during the charge.

params.tips:
* The scoreboard's question mark of '''Neeko''' (which indicates an enemy is not currently visible to your team) will disappear if the {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}} '''Neeko''' is visible. Therefore, it can be used to determine whether a unit that recently appeared on the map is '''Neeko''' or not.
* Before disguising as a {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|ward}} using the {{tip|lunge|leap}}, '''Neeko''' should be positioned close enough to reach the desired unit's position before the disguise is completed in order to preserve the unit's original facing direction.<!--is this a good tip? it's "practical" but also obvious from the notes-->
* Since '''Neeko''' disguising does not interrupt ongoing ''Sho'Ma'' gathering, '''Neeko''' can disguise as a champion to prevent herself from switching the target of gathering.
* While {{tip|channel|channeling}} {{si|Hexflash}}, '''Neeko''' can disguise as a unit with less than {{as|200|movement speed}} to override its {{as|movement speed}} cap, which will allow her to move during the channel.
* {{cais|Above and Below|Bel'Veth}} {{ai|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}} {{sti|cooldown}} reset will not count '''Neeko''' when disguised as a non-champion because it is applied before the {{tip|airborne|knockup}}.

params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' creates a {{tip|clone}} of her {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|current form}}, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisible}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and gain {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. params.description3:
The clone lasts for 3 seconds, moves a fixed distance in the target direction, and is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and for the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of its lifespan to enemies. If the clone takes [[damage]], it will disappear prematurely after {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

Casting an ability, summoner spell, item active, or starting a {{tip|channel}} causes the clone to stop moving. Additionally, the clone plays the {{tt|casting animations|See notes}} for ''{{ai|Blooming Burst|Neeko}}'' and ''{{ai|Tangle-Barbs|Neeko}}'' as well as ''{{ais|Pop Blossom|Neeko}}'' {{tt|visual effects|See notes, only visible from the enemy's perspective}} whenever '''Neeko''' casts them. The clone will also play the animation of her next [[Emoting|expression]] or {{si|Recall}} for a {{tt|set duration|See notes}} that overrides its original duration and will become unable to move while doing so.
params.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Neeko''' sends her clone to the target location if it is not playing an expression or {{si|Recall}} animation.
params.notes:
<!--onhit-->
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}} and [[jungle plants]].
* The damage done by the empowered attack is attributed to {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko}} in the [[Death Recap]].{{bug}}
<!--actual ability-->
* Using a basic attack {{tip|breaks stealth}} at the start of the attack windup.
* Recasting ''Shapesplitter'' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Once spawned with a {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguise}}, the clone cannot lose the disguise.
* When mimicking the animation of {{ai|Blooming Burst|Neeko}} and {{ai|Tangle-Barbs|Neeko}} while disguised, the clone will play the disguise unit's first and third ability animation respectively.
* When mimicking the animation of ''Blooming Burst'', the clone will turn toward ''Blooming Burst's'' target location unless it was ordered to move within the last {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|estimated}} seconds, in which case it will not change its facing direction.{{bug}}
* When mimicking the animation of ''Tangle-Barbs'', the clone will always face to the east.{{bug}}
* If ''Shapesplitter'' is cast during {{ais|Pop Blossom|Neeko}} delay, the clone will also mimic the ability by displaying the VFX for its area of effect. The copied VFX is only visible to enemies, and only while they have {{tip|sight}} of '''Neeko'''.{{bug|2}}
* When '''Neeko''' forces her clone to play an expression or {{si|Recall}} animation, she modifies its duration based on the animation played.
** Joke - 8 seconds.
** Dance - 8 seconds.
** Taunt - {{fd|4.25}} seconds.
** Laugh - 3 seconds.
** {{si|Recall}} - 8 seconds.
** {{si|Empowered Recall}} - 4 seconds.
*** When attempting to play the {{si|Empowered Recall}} animation, the clone will instead play the non-empowered ''Recall'' VFX if '''Neeko's''' player account is [[Rank#Season_&_Rewards|challenger]] or [[Honor#Overview|level 5 honor]].{{bug}}
* While playing an expression or recall animation, the clone cannot move via pathing, even if it is affected by a {{tip|forced action}}.
* The clone is special-cased to not apply {{iis|Frozen Heart}} {{nie|Winter's Caress}}<!--(this one is no longer relevant as of 14.19) and the slow from {{iis|Celestial Opposition}} {{nie|Blessing of the Mountain}}--> after the clone's base duration (3 seconds) has elapsed.
** This effect can still apply before that, including if the clone disappears prior to the base duration elapsing.{{bug|2}}
* The clone will sometimes not disappear prematurely after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of taking damage from certain sources.{{bug}}<!--allegedly ignores dot damage but unclear-->
* Both '''Neeko''' and the clone use the same running animation.
** When passing near a [[Jungling|jungle camp]] for the first time, '''Neeko''' will wave at the camp. The clone will likewise wave at nearby camps every time it is spawned, which can override the running animation and allow players to recognize the clone.{{bug}}
* The clone can still be targeted by allied {{tip|auto-targeted}} effects (e.g. {{si|Heal}}, {{ai|Celestial Blessing|Kayle}}).
* The clone benefits from allied {{bi|Speed Shrine|Speed Shrine}}, despite being {{tip|untargetable}} to allies.{{bug|2|Originally this template said "this may bot be intended", which would be a more accurate note; presumably the speed shrine buff comes from a neutral monster and that's why it can affect the clone}}
<!--start of clone disguise interactions-->
* While disguised as any non-champion other than a ''small'' or ''medium'' {{ui|Krug}}, the clone will display the [[Minion#Behavior|aggro]] icon while standing idle.{{bug}}

description.plain: Passive: Neeko's basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Shapesplitter, which refreshes on subsequent attacks and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, her next basic attack on-attack consumes them all to become non-projectile, deal bonus magic damage and grant her bonus movement speed for 1 second. This attack deals 75 bonus magic damage against monsters.

description2.plain: Active: Neeko creates a clone of her Inherent Glamour, after which they both instantly become invisible for 0.5 seconds and gain bonus movement speed for 3 seconds. Shapesplitter can be recast at any time while the clone is active.

description3.plain: The clone lasts for 3 seconds, moves a fixed distance in the target direction, and is untargetable to allies and for the first 0.5 seconds of its lifespan to enemies. If the clone takes damage, it will disappear prematurely after 0.5 seconds. Casting an ability, summoner spell, item active, or starting a channel causes the clone to stop moving. Additionally, the clone plays the casting animations for Blooming Burst and Tangle-Barbs as well as Pop Blossom visual effects whenever Neeko casts them. The clone will also play the animation of her next expression or Recall for a set duration that overrides its original duration and will become unable to move while doing so.

description4.plain: Recast: Neeko sends her clone to the target location if it is not playing an expression or Recall animation.

blurb3.plain: Recast: Neeko directs the clone to the target location.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' winds up spiritual essence over {{fd|1.25}} seconds and highlights an area around herself, which is visible to enemies unless she is ''{{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}}''. If '''Neeko''' is in a ''{{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguise}}'', it will break after {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the duration.
params.description2: After winding up, the cast time begins and '''Neeko''' leaps upward, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies for {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
params.description3: When the cast time ends, she lands to emit a burst of energy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.notes:
'''Ability details:'''
* The wind up uses a special bar similar to cast bars to represent when ''Pop Blossom's'' cast time will start.
** The wind up has no special interactions.
* The highlighted area is fixed around '''Neeko'''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block either the knock up or damage and stun, but not both.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
'''Interactions:'''
* On-cast effects are applied on activation.
* ''Pop Blossom'' can start its cast time during {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
